replacement_rules.absolute_path: Canonical absolute target path with no symlink aliases.
replacement_rules.integer: Generate nonnegative integer local values; int(token) wrappers may be replaced with decimal integer literals.
replacement_rules.path_component: One nonempty filename component; reject slashes, dot and dot-dot.
replacement_rules.python_string: Substitute with Python-literal-safe escaping and verify resulting AST; do not interpolate untrusted source.
replacement_rules.relative_path: Canonical relative path beneath declared root; reject absolute paths, traversal and aliases.

replacement_rules.unknown_tokens: Refuse unresolved, undeclared or inconsistent tokens.
